leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a basic retry mechanism with exponential backoff for failed API calls
Configure jitter parameters to randomize delay intervals between retry attempts
Construct a reusable utility function that encapsulates retry-with-jitter logic
Integrate the retry utility with a simulated upstream service call
Manipulate retry configuration options such as maximum attempts and base delay
Initialize and control retry behavior through configurable parameters
Apply error handling patterns to manage different failure scenarios during retries
lessonTitle: Build retry with jitter utility for upstream calls
